text:
kayla: hey folks — tiny non-work PSA: Hosted API just hit 1,000,000 requests this month. wild. big thanks to everyone who triaged last-week spikes :tada::confetti_ball:
omar: YESS!!! thats huge. low-key want a sticker or something :sticker:
ted: Stickers > hoodies (economical and good for laptops) :+1:
jin: can we do a 10-min midnight toast for US folks and a 9am one for EU? timezones are always :exploding_head:
marie: also tiny kudos to @ingest for the retry fix — cut p99 latency by ~30ms yesterday :clap:
ops-bot: AlertBot: Autoscaler maintained target latency during peak traffic. No incidents recorded in last 24h.
kayla: poll (react): :sticker: sticker / :hoodie: hoodie / :pizza: team lunch / :doughnut: donuts
omar: :sticker:
ted: :pizza: (unless it's vegan-friendly)
jin: :doughnut: (i have a sweet tooth)
marie: :sticker: and also kudos banner for the office whiteboard
kayla: noted — stickers are slightly ahead. anyone want to design a mockup? small prize (coffee + sticker pack) for winner :coffee::art:
omar: i can throw together a quick mock in Figma tonight
ted: i drew a bad pixel art concept: 
```
  +-----------+
  | 1M 🚀     |
  | Redwood  |
  +-----------+
```
jin: love the pixel vibe tbh :joy:
marie: remote folks — will post a Zoom link for the toast. planning 11:50pm PT / 7:50am GMT (tomorrow) so EU can join before work
ok: ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Zoom link posted in thread in 5m.
kayla: thanks team. quick humble brag: our cost per 1k tokens dropped 12% this month thanks to batching + quantization experiments. feel good about that. truly proud :heart:
omar: celebratory GIF incoming :party_parrot:
ted: can we also get a tiny plaque for the kitchen? "1M requests" feels like a fun milestone to celebrate physically
jin: +1 plaque
marie: will coordinate logistics for stickers/plaque/food. everyone drop dietary restrictions here if you havent
omar: vegetarian ok
ted: vegan pls if ordering pizza
jin: gluten-free if possible
kayla: added to the list. see you at the toast :champagne:
